descriptor.label: HL7 v2 segment guide
descriptor.description: Export the types as an HL7 v2 message and segment definition guide (JSON, CSV and Markdown).

message_type.description: The message type, `<code>^<event>` or `<code>^<event>^<structure>` (`ADT^A01`, `ORU^R01`). Default: an imported HL7 v2 item's own, else `ZZZ^Z01` (a site-defined message).
message_type.title: Message Type

version.description: The HL7 v2 version (`2.3`, `2.5.1`, `2.8` …). Default: an imported HL7 v2 item's own, else `2.5.1`. From 2.6 a timestamp is `DTM`, from 2.7 a coded value is `CWE`.
version.title: Version

default_field_length.description: Maximum length of a text field with no maxLength.
default_field_length.title: Default Field Length

max_code_length.description: The longest code an enum value may be used as directly; a longer value (or one that is not upper-case letters and digits) gets a synthesized code.
max_code_length.title: Max Code Length

first_table_number.description: The number of the first user-defined table (one per enum, numbered in order).
first_table_number.title: First Table Number
